proposal.behavior: Authorize personal environment deletion by owner
proposal.trigger: User A deletes an environment ID belonging to user B.
proposal.expected: The delete query includes A UID and cannot remove B environment.
proposal.violation_example: An ID-only delete removes B environment.

necessity_rationale: The change adds userUid to the delete query (diff 836-839), defining deletion isolation by owner.
responsibility_rationale: The query condition and deletion operation are in the same service; the local boundary is userEnvironment.delete.

proposal.behavior: Hide the routing infrastructure label from preview details
proposal.trigger: An alert instance contains NAMED_ROOT_LABEL_NAME and an ordinary label.
proposal.expected: Only ordinary labels appear as potential instance details.
proposal.violation_example: The internal routing label is shown to users.

necessity_rationale: The change adds stripInternalLabels and calls it in preview-details mapping (diff 127, 147), requiring internal routing labels to be hidden.
responsibility_rationale: The label-cleaning function is called across the boundary to alert-preview display data.

proposal.behavior: Export the current full collection for auto-sync documents
proposal.trigger: A published user or team document has autoSync enabled and its collection has nested children.
proposal.expected: Public retrieval exports the current full collection without caller-controlled tree filtering.
proposal.violation_example: The response uses a stale tree or truncates children because of a shallow-export option.

necessity_rationale: The autoSync branch calls full collection export and recursively queries children (diff 418-426, 702), defining live-tree output.
responsibility_rationale: Public document retrieval, collection export, and recursive database queries connect across modules.

proposal.behavior: Notify readiness only once per element
proposal.trigger: The same element undergoes an effect rerun or a configuration update.
proposal.expected: Call onElementReady only for the first readiness notification.
proposal.violation_example: Repeat the readiness notification on every configure call.

necessity_rationale: The ready-element guard (diff 49) limits notification to initial readiness rather than every effect rerun.
responsibility_rationale: Notification is controlled within the same React effect and ready-element set.

proposal.behavior: Report enabled transport features
proposal.trigger: Options enable some of OAuth2, DKIM, pooling, proxy, rate limiting or required TLS.
proposal.expected: Features reflect enabled options and omit absent options.
proposal.violation_example: Enabled proxy is unreported, or absent flags are always listed.

necessity_rationale: Feature construction adds proxy and requireTLS conditions (diff 194-196), requiring output to match enabled options.
responsibility_rationale: The conversion occurs within one options-to-features function.

proposal.behavior: Fill missing components when parsing short versions
proposal.trigger: The input is 1 or 1.2.
proposal.expected: major=1 and missing minor or patch components become zero.
proposal.violation_example: Continue requiring three components and reject a short version.

necessity_rationale: Parsing uses a nullish fallback of zero for missing components (diff 50), defining compatibility with 1 and 1.2.
responsibility_rationale: Number mapping and defaults are handled within the version-string parser.

proposal.behavior: updateUserProfile converts primitive values directly and serializes non-primitive values into user_properties before posting
proposal.trigger: A profile contains string, number, boolean, null, or object/array property values.
proposal.expected: Each property is wrapped as {value}; complex values are JSON-stringified and an update_user_profile event is sent.
proposal.violation_example: Passing an object directly would violate the GA user property value type.

necessity_rationale: updateUserProfile/buildUserProperties and JSON.stringify (diff 93, 97, 183) define primitive wrapping and serialization of complex values before reporting.
responsibility_rationale: The user-profile conversion function crosses a data-contract boundary to the analytics event interface.

proposal.behavior: Group nonzero line discounts by type and total their amounts
proposal.trigger: Order lines contain repeated discount types, quantities and zero-discount lines.
proposal.expected: Count discounted lines per type and sum unit discount times quantity; omit zero entries.
proposal.violation_example: The total ignores quantity or includes zero-discount lines.

necessity_rationale: Discount aggregation adds unitDiscount * quantity and skips zero values (diff 1701-1708), defining line-level totals.
responsibility_rationale: Order-line discount reduction and grouping are within the same summary component.

proposal.behavior: Honor per-role template visibility
proposal.trigger: Admin, manager and member search three template visibility levels.
proposal.expected: Return the exact permitted template subset.
proposal.violation_example: Manager gets an ADMIN template in place of a manager template.

necessity_rationale: Search and the role-visibility predicate (diff 371, 492) change the visible template set, requiring the precise subset for each role.
responsibility_rationale: Template search calls permission checks across query and authorization-filtering boundaries.

proposal.behavior: Use shop stock mode in availability diagnostics
proposal.trigger: The query returns an explicit true/false stock mode, or shop data is absent.
proposal.expected: Expose that mode and pass it into availability checks, with legacy=true fallback when absent.
proposal.violation_example: Direct mode is replaced by legacy mode or never reaches availability checks.

necessity_rationale: The query adds useLegacyShippingZoneStockAvailability and forwards it to availability checks (diff 325, 350), defining explicit-value and fallback behavior.
responsibility_rationale: GraphQL/shop data is passed across the boundary to availability-diagnostic arguments.

proposal.behavior: Restrict personal collection export and duplication to the owner
proposal.trigger: User exports a collection subtree or duplicates it from a supplied collection ID.
proposal.expected: Every root and recursive child lookup remains scoped to that user.
proposal.violation_example: An ID-only lookup leaks a foreign subtree during export or duplication.

necessity_rationale: Both root and recursive subtree queries are bound to userID (diff 650, 733), requiring export/copy isolation by owner.
responsibility_rationale: Root queries, recursive queries, and export/copy entry points cross multiple collection-service call boundaries.

proposal.behavior: Show combined order and line discount in the collapsed summary
proposal.trigger: An order has an order-level and line-level discount.
proposal.expected: The collapsed discount row shows their combined amount.
proposal.violation_example: The collapsed row shows only the order discount.

necessity_rationale: Order-level and line-level discounts are combined (diff 1499-1501), defining the collapsed summary amount.
responsibility_rationale: Amount calculation and rendering occur within the same order-discount summary component.

proposal.behavior: Expose API grant controls in the E2E test environment even when flags are off
proposal.trigger: NEXT_PUBLIC_NODE_ENV is test while either or both feature flags are false.
proposal.expected: The grant-control hook returns true so the controls can be exercised by E2E tests.
proposal.violation_example: The hook still returns false because it requires live feature flags in test mode.

necessity_rationale: The test environment bypasses runtime flags (diff 41, 59), defining grant controls usable by E2E tests.
responsibility_rationale: Environment-variable checks connect frontend permission controls to the E2E entry point.

proposal.behavior: Expose runtime initialization and history loading in the chat
proposal.trigger: Runtime readiness is initializing or history.loading is true, then both become ready.
proposal.expected: The chat reports loading until initialization and history loading both finish.
proposal.violation_example: The history spinner disappears while runtime history is still loading.

necessity_rationale: The change checks runtime readiness and history.loading together (diff 164), defining combined loading state.
responsibility_rationale: Runtime initialization and history loading converge at the chat UI.

proposal.behavior: Keep rendered message identity separate across tabs
proposal.trigger: Two chat tabs contain messages with the same message ID.
proposal.expected: The rendering key includes the active tab or session so switching tabs does not reuse the old message element.
proposal.violation_example: A message from the previous tab remains attached to a same-ID message in the new tab.

necessity_rationale: The rendering key includes active tab/tabKey (diff 346-350), preventing reuse of same-ID messages across tabs.
responsibility_rationale: Isolation is implemented within message-list key generation.

proposal.behavior: Clear recently viewed dashboard history
proposal.trigger: Recent list contains dashboard impressions and user clicks Clear history.
proposal.expected: Clear the organization-scoped stored impressions and reload the recent list.
proposal.violation_example: The displayed list disappears without clearing storage or the list never refreshes.

necessity_rationale: After clearing impressions, the change calls retry (diff 41, 292-293), requiring persistent clearing and list refresh.
responsibility_rationale: The organization impression service connects to homepage-list request refresh.

proposal.behavior: Stop a BYOK request when local lease creation fails
proposal.trigger: A workspace has local BYOK providers and its lease mutation fails.
proposal.expected: The request surfaces an error and never starts a remote text stream without the lease.
proposal.violation_example: The request proceeds without the intended local-provider lease.

necessity_rationale: Local-lease failure becomes a user error (diff 1261, 1351), requiring the remote stream to stop when the lease is absent.
responsibility_rationale: The local lease-mutation result controls remote text-stream startup.

proposal.behavior: Give each issue severity its own labeled visual
proposal.trigger: An error, warning or info callout/badge is shown.
proposal.expected: Render the matching visual and accessible severity label, including Information for info advisories.
proposal.violation_example: Info is rendered as a warning or icons lack accessible labels.

necessity_rationale: The change defines severity-to-visual and aria-label mappings (diff 248, 291, 513).
responsibility_rationale: Visual selection and attribute rendering occur within the same issue-callout component.

proposal.behavior: Send installed apps without appUrl to their manage screen
proposal.trigger: An active installed third-party app has no appUrl, compared with an active app that has one.
proposal.expected: The no-URL app link targets the manage/edit route; the configured app link targets its view route.
proposal.violation_example: An active app with no appUrl opens an unusable iframe view.

necessity_rationale: isActive/appUrl select manage or view routes (diff 183, 201), requiring manage when no URL exists.
responsibility_rationale: Route selection is within the installed-application link builder.

proposal.behavior: Reject a foreign parent when creating a personal collection
proposal.trigger: User creates a child collection under a parent owned by another user.
proposal.expected: Parent lookup is scoped to that user and creation fails without attaching under the foreign parent.
proposal.violation_example: The child is created under an ID-only foreign parent.

necessity_rationale: Parent lookup adds user.uid (diff 333, 336), preventing use of another user's parent collection for personal collection creation.
responsibility_rationale: Parent lookup and validation before insertion occur within the same creation service.

proposal.behavior: Restrict plugin behavior to component references
proposal.trigger: A typed PayloadComponent string, an object path/exportName, and an unrelated string occur in one TS project.
proposal.expected: Recognize the component forms, including their sibling values, without treating unrelated strings as component references.
proposal.violation_example: Ordinary strings receive component diagnostics or component suggestions, or object exportName is ignored.

necessity_rationale: Component-reference resolution returns distinct contexts (diff 21, 41, 46), constraining recognition of typed component/path/exportName.
responsibility_rationale: The plugin-resolution entry crosses a data boundary to component-node/export resolution results.

proposal.behavior: Sum API-provided undiscounted line totals
proposal.trigger: Order lines contain gross and net undiscounted totals.
proposal.expected: Sum the requested gross or net API total across lines.
proposal.violation_example: The subtotal recomputes from discounted unit prices or always chooses gross.

necessity_rationale: The change reads undiscounted gross/net (diff 1741-1742), requiring both pre-discount subtotal amounts.
responsibility_rationale: Mapping order-line amounts to subtotal display occurs within one component.

proposal.behavior: Provide a useful missing-export message
proposal.trigger: A component names a missing export in a module that has other exports.
proposal.expected: The diagnostic names the missing export and offers a spelling suggestion when available, otherwise lists available exports.
proposal.violation_example: The diagnostic gives no candidate export or names the wrong missing member.

necessity_rationale: Export failure produces spelling suggestions and available exports (diff 439, 443), defining error guidance.
responsibility_rationale: Dynamic export-resolution errors cross into error messages and user guidance.

proposal.behavior: Do not render empty category or delivery sections
proposal.trigger: Issues include only one recognized category, no issues, or solely an unrecognized future category.
proposal.expected: Only populated recognized sections appear; no empty bordered delivery section appears.
proposal.violation_example: An empty category heading or empty delivery box remains visible.

necessity_rationale: Section rendering depends on whether two arrays are empty (diff 41, 66, 73), requiring empty categories to be omitted.
responsibility_rationale: Conditional rendering occurs within the same issues panel.

proposal.behavior: Order calculation uses the active channel tax zone
proposal.trigger: An order is calculated under two channels with different tax zones using a context whose channel changes.
proposal.expected: OrderCalculator resolves the tax zone for each active channel rather than reusing the other channel cached value.
proposal.violation_example: The second channel inherits the first channel tax zone from an unscoped cache entry.

necessity_rationale: channelId is included in the ActiveTaxZone cache key (diff 17, 33), preventing tax-zone reuse across channels.
responsibility_rationale: The order calculator crosses a key-contract boundary to the shared tax-zone cache.

proposal.behavior: Name voucher and promotion sources in line discounts
proposal.trigger: A line has no discount, an unnamed voucher, a named promotion, or multiple discounts.
proposal.expected: The source text uses the correct type label, includes names and separates multiple entries.
proposal.violation_example: A promotion is named as a voucher or multiple sources merge without separation.

necessity_rationale: A source list and separator format discount origins (diff 559, 571), defining multiple-source labels.
responsibility_rationale: List joining occurs within the discount-source formatter.

proposal.behavior: Search permitted templates by title or recipient email
proposal.trigger: Own/team templates coexist with other-team and soft-deleted templates.
proposal.expected: Return matching nondeleted accessible templates.
proposal.violation_example: Deleted or other-team templates are returned, or recipient email never matches.

necessity_rationale: Search is limited to EnvelopeType.TEMPLATE and supports secondaryId mapping (diff 546, 599), defining template search scope.
responsibility_rationale: Search queries, legacy-ID mapping, and template entity type connect across layers.

proposal.behavior: Keep the current shipping address visible during editing
proposal.trigger: The order has a shipping address and the user clicks its Edit button.
proposal.expected: The existing shipping address remains visible while the selector is available.
proposal.violation_example: Clicking Edit replaces the address with a No shipping address placeholder.

necessity_rationale: shippingAddress display is retained while selecting an address (diff 64, 86), requiring address visibility during editing.
responsibility_rationale: Address selection and field-state rendering occur within the same form.

proposal.behavior: Extract nested comments while preserving quoted parentheses
proposal.trigger: Address text contains nested comments and quoted literal parentheses.
proposal.expected: Remove comments into an ordered list; preserve quoted content.
proposal.violation_example: Nested comments are cut short or quoted parentheses are stripped.

necessity_rationale: Depth and quote-state parsing are added (diff 164-169), preventing comment extraction from splitting quoted content.
responsibility_rationale: A single text scanner maintains depth/inQuotes state.

proposal.behavior: Deduplicate slots by instant and duration
proposal.trigger: The input has two equal (startTime, duration) pairs and a pair with the same instant but different duration.
proposal.expected: Equal pairs collapse to one; differing durations remain distinct.
proposal.violation_example: Deduplication compares only startTime and drops a distinct duration.

necessity_rationale: The startTime/duration composite key deduplicates slots (diff 33), defining retention of duplicate slots.
responsibility_rationale: Key construction and deduplication are within the slot-list merge function.

proposal.behavior: Attribute an action result to its initiating host
proposal.trigger: Two hosts have interleaved actions and the first host reports a result.
proposal.expected: The result event is attributed to that host action.
proposal.violation_example: The result is attributed to the most recent action on another host.

necessity_rationale: actionHistory is filtered by item.options.host (diff 1906), defining isolation of action results by host.
responsibility_rationale: Action-history lookup and host matching occur in one service.

proposal.behavior: Keep view options open while navigating nested pages
proposal.trigger: The user enters a nested view-options page and uses Back.
proposal.expected: The menu returns to the prior page without closing, then closes only on explicit dismissal.
proposal.violation_example: Back unexpectedly closes the menu and loses navigation context.

necessity_rationale: View-option results determine page navigation (diff 67, 4180), defining return behavior for non-main pages.
responsibility_rationale: The view-option action result connects to router/page state.

proposal.behavior: Include unresolved info advisories in the healthy summary
proposal.trigger: With full permissions, there are zero, one or multiple info advisories and no errors/warnings; warnings instead own the banner when present.
proposal.expected: Render no advisory suffix for zero, a singular count for one and the actual plural count for more; suppress this success banner when warnings exist.
proposal.violation_example: Show an unqualified healthy message despite an advisory, or show a literal count placeholder.

necessity_rationale: infoCount distinguishes zero, one, and multiple suggestions (diff 82-84), defining healthy/advisory banner text states.
responsibility_rationale: Count-based rendering branches occur within one banner component.

proposal.behavior: Use workspace wording in settings, permissions and languages
proposal.trigger: Workspace settings or language management is rendered, or a workspace permission/action error occurs.
proposal.expected: Visible labels, confirmations and error messages use workspace terminology and the updated translation keys.
proposal.violation_example: One surface continues showing project wording or a missing translation key.

necessity_rationale: Workspace permission, language, and deletion text keys are unified (diff 98, 386, 713), defining user-visible copy.
responsibility_rationale: Translation keys on multiple pages connect to workspace-settings flows across components.

proposal.behavior: Navigate to workspace routes from environment and project controls
proposal.trigger: User opens project configuration or switches projects from the environment navigation.
proposal.expected: The destination uses /workspace/ settings routes and /workspaces/ project landing routes.
proposal.violation_example: Navigation still points to the removed /project/ or /projects/ URLs.

necessity_rationale: Workspace paths, match patterns, and push calls are updated (diff 111, 214, 284), defining navigation entry points.
responsibility_rationale: Route patterns, navigation calls, and page hierarchy connect across entry points.

proposal.behavior: Place articles without positions after positioned articles
proposal.trigger: Numeric, null, and undefined positions are mixed.
proposal.expected: Place both null and undefined positions after numeric entries.
proposal.violation_example: Treat null as zero and place it early.

necessity_rationale: Sorting defaults position to Infinity (diff 16), defining stable placement of entries without positions.
responsibility_rationale: Default handling occurs within the same sorting comparator.

proposal.behavior: Export parser and suggestion functions through the public snoozeDateParser entry
proposal.trigger: Both functions are imported from the snoozeDateParser directory entry.
proposal.expected: Make parseDateFromText and generateDateSuggestions callable through that entry.
proposal.violation_example: Omit either export or require importing an internal file.

necessity_rationale: The module exports parser/localization APIs (diff 17-18), defining an externally accessible public entry.
responsibility_rationale: The module export boundary connects implementation files to consumers.

proposal.behavior: Default relationOpenMode to modal
proposal.trigger: The schema does not configure relationOpenMode and createDefaultSettings is called.
proposal.expected: Return relationOpenMode: modal.
proposal.violation_example: Omit the field or return page.

necessity_rationale: relationOpenMode defaults to modal (diff 9), defining how relation fields open.
responsibility_rationale: The field default is set within a single configuration object.

proposal.behavior: Reject malformed and excessive discount values
proposal.trigger: A user enters malformed, zero or above-limit percentage/fixed values.
proposal.expected: The form shows the matching error and disables confirmation.
proposal.violation_example: The form submits 150% or a fixed amount above the order maximum.

necessity_rationale: Format/range validation disables submission on errors (diff 770, 785), defining form rejection rules.
responsibility_rationale: Input-validation results cross into submit-control availability.

proposal.behavior: Initialize a ready draft tab when no historical session exists
proposal.trigger: The document scope has no pinned, pending, or document session.
proposal.expected: Readiness is ready, activeSessionId is empty, tabs contains only draft, and messages is empty.
proposal.violation_example: Initialization fails, activates the wrong session, or omits the draft tab.

necessity_rationale: With no session, the change creates a ready draft session (diff 289-292), defining usable initialization state.
responsibility_rationale: The session-strategy creation result connects to readiness state.

proposal.behavior: Product pricing uses the active channel tax zone
proposal.trigger: One request context prices a variant in channel A, then switches to channel B with a different default tax zone.
proposal.expected: ProductPriceApplicator computes B tax using B zone, and switching back still computes A tax using A zone.
proposal.violation_example: A shared cache entry causes channel B to reuse the tax zone calculated for A.

necessity_rationale: The independent ActiveTaxZone_PPA(channelId) key (diff 18, 50) defines channel isolation in PPA calculations.
responsibility_rationale: PPA order calculation crosses a key boundary to the shared tax-zone cache.

proposal.behavior: Keep the latest external calendar response
proposal.trigger: Two calendar-range loads overlap and the older one completes last.
proposal.expected: The view retains the latest request result.
proposal.violation_example: An old month response replaces the active month entries.

necessity_rationale: An increasing requestId discards stale responses (diff 1349, 1363), requiring only the latest concurrent calendar response to remain.
responsibility_rationale: The asynchronous request lifecycle crosses into external-entries UI state.

proposal.behavior: Report loading errors and retry each list
proposal.trigger: Recent or starred request is pending or fails.
proposal.expected: Show list-specific loading/error feedback and let Retry rerun the failed request.
proposal.violation_example: An error looks like an empty list or Retry does not rerun the request.

necessity_rationale: Loading/error rendering and retry binding (diff 245, 249, 255) define list-level feedback and retry.
responsibility_rationale: Request state, list components, and retry callbacks connect multiple entry points.

proposal.behavior: Combine built-in and saved segments with distinct IDs and refreshed date ranges
proposal.trigger: System and user segments coexist, including relative date filters.
proposal.expected: Keep identities distinct, refresh relative ranges and display system/personal/team groups.
proposal.violation_example: ID collision selects the wrong type or date filter remains stale.

necessity_rationale: System/user segments are combined, relative dates refreshed, and grouping retained (diff 600, 967, 984), defining the combined list.
responsibility_rationale: System/user sources, date conversion, and menu display connect across modules.

proposal.behavior: Choose form defaults according to nullable field type
proposal.trigger: Default generation receives nullable String/ID/LanguageCode/Boolean and numeric/date fields, including lists.
proposal.expected: String/ID use empty text, LanguageCode uses supplied/default language, Boolean false, numeric/date scalars null, lists empty arrays.
proposal.violation_example: A nullable date receives empty text or a nullable list receives null.

necessity_rationale: Nullable status and scalar type select defaults (diff 9, 15), defining the form-initialization matrix.
responsibility_rationale: Type branches occur within the default-value generator.

proposal.behavior: Drop an extension whose relative URL cannot be resolved
proposal.trigger: An extension URL is relative and its parent app has no appUrl; an absolute URL may still be present.
proposal.expected: The unresolved relative extension is omitted, while an absolute URL remains usable.
proposal.violation_example: The relative extension appears with a broken destination, or the absolute extension is discarded too.

necessity_rationale: Unresolvable relative URLs are dropped while absolute URLs remain (diff 13, 19), defining extension filtering.
responsibility_rationale: The extension URL parsing/filtering function makes the decision locally.

proposal.behavior: Send resolved messages from dashboard forms
proposal.trigger: User creates/updates, moves or deletes a provisioned dashboard with a repository template.
proposal.expected: The corresponding request carries the rendered template using the actual dashboard action and details.
proposal.violation_example: Helper works alone but one dashboard form still sends a hardcoded message.

necessity_rationale: Delete/move/create/update actions are passed to requests (diff 463, 491, 519), defining form commit messages.
responsibility_rationale: Multiple dashboard forms connect to the shared commit request.

proposal.behavior: Convert entered discount value when switching mode
proposal.trigger: A user switches an entered fixed discount to percentage or the reverse.
proposal.expected: Preserve equivalent discount value using the order maximum and round to two decimals.
proposal.violation_example: Switching mode keeps the same numeric value with a different unit.

necessity_rationale: Switching fixed/percentage discounts converts using maxAmount and writes back the value (diff 681, 750), defining equivalent-value conversion.
responsibility_rationale: Discount conversion and field-state updates occur within the same form component.

proposal.behavior: Open the associated voucher from the discount summary
proposal.trigger: A voucher discount has a voucher ID and the user selects its name.
proposal.expected: Navigate to that voucher detail.
proposal.violation_example: The voucher name is inert or opens an unrelated voucher.

necessity_rationale: voucherId is passed to voucherUrl and pushed (diff 1299), defining navigation from the discount summary to voucher details.
responsibility_rationale: The summary component crosses a navigation boundary to the voucher route.

proposal.behavior: Encode short non-ASCII names while retaining ASCII names
proposal.trigger: An ASCII or short non-ASCII display name is passed to either encoder.
proposal.expected: ASCII remains unchanged; the other name receives its UTF-8 Base64 or Q encoding.
proposal.violation_example: ASCII is encoded unnecessarily or non-ASCII is corrupted.

necessity_rationale: Base64/Quoted-Printable encoders preserve ASCII (diff 91, 134), defining both encoder behaviors.
responsibility_rationale: Character-set and ASCII branches occur within the encoding functions.

proposal.behavior: Unquote and unescape quoted display names
proposal.trigger: Display name is quoted with an escaped quote, or unquoted.
proposal.expected: Remove outer quoting and escape markers; retain an unquoted name.
proposal.violation_example: Escaped quote loses its character or outer quotes remain.

necessity_rationale: Outer quotes are removed and escapes handled (diff 226, 233), defining display-name decoding.
responsibility_rationale: Parsing occurs within the single unquoteString function.

proposal.behavior: Expose undiscounted subtotal when it differs from the displayed subtotal
proposal.trigger: Discounts make the order subtotal lower than the gross undiscounted subtotal.
proposal.expected: A tooltip shows the before-discounts amount, and is absent when amounts match.
proposal.violation_example: The before-discounts amount is unavailable or shown for unchanged orders.

necessity_rationale: A tooltip is rendered only when undiscounted and displayed subtotals differ (diff 1621, 1631), defining conditional guidance.
responsibility_rationale: Amount comparison and data-test/tooltip rendering occur within the subtotal component.

proposal.behavior: Show purchasability and shipping issues under separate headings
proposal.trigger: A channel has issues from both categories.
proposal.expected: Each issue appears under its own correctly named category section, with no old generic heading.
proposal.violation_example: Shipping issues appear under Purchasability or all issues remain in one generic Delivery configuration block.

necessity_rationale: Purchasability/shipping classification (diff 36-37) defines group headings and membership.
responsibility_rationale: Filtering and rendering both categories occur within the same issues panel.

proposal.behavior: Split long encoded names without splitting a UTF-8 character
proposal.trigger: A non-ASCII name exceeds one encoded-word chunk.
proposal.expected: Each word fits the declared length limit and decoding the words reconstructs the original name.
proposal.violation_example: The result is one overlong word or split bytes corrupt a character.

necessity_rationale: Chunk byte limits and fallback to complete UTF-8 character boundaries (diff 101, 116) define long-word splitting.
responsibility_rationale: Encoding chunking maintains length and character boundaries within one function.

proposal.behavior: Resolve eligible host default conferencing preferences
proposal.trigger: A host has a dynamic app or static link; organizer-default is configured on a team/managed event, or these eligibility conditions are absent.
proposal.expected: Use the dynamic location type or static URL only when both the location setting and event eligibility permit it; otherwise use event locations.
proposal.violation_example: A normal personal event or an event without organizer-default unexpectedly adopts the host default.

necessity_rationale: Event eligibility and static/dynamic location are checked together (diff 337, 343), defining adoption of a host default.
responsibility_rationale: Event permission/type settings and host-location configuration jointly determine the output.

proposal.behavior: Restore address editing state when the selector closes
proposal.trigger: The Edit selector is open and the user dismisses it without choosing an address.
proposal.expected: The popover closes and the page leaves editing mode, restoring the Edit control.
proposal.violation_example: The selector closes but the page stays in editing mode with no Edit control.

necessity_rationale: Selector cancellation clears editing state (diff 34-35, 65, 109), defining restoration after closing.
responsibility_rationale: Selector callbacks connect to shipping/billing form state across two entry points.

proposal.behavior: Enter workspace onboarding and present workspace identity
proposal.trigger: New user starts onboarding and creates a workspace.
proposal.expected: Onboarding uses /workspaces/new and workspace labels in creation settings.
proposal.violation_example: The onboarding flow waits at an old projects/new path or presents project creation labels.

necessity_rationale: Onboarding paths and project/workspace text are migrated (diff 4, 51), defining the new workspace entry.
responsibility_rationale: Route renaming and onboarding/settings-page copy coordinate across files.

proposal.behavior: Convert nullable non-string empty values recursively
proposal.trigger: Values contain empty nullable non-strings, empty Strings and required fields in objects and list elements.
proposal.expected: Only empty nullable non-strings become null; string and required fields are retained at every nested level.
proposal.violation_example: Empty String becomes null or a nested list date stays empty.

necessity_rationale: Recursive conversion turns nullable non-string empty values into null while preserving String/required values (diff 91, 99).
responsibility_rationale: The recursive conversion function handles objects and list elements locally.

proposal.behavior: Respect ownership rules for personal and team segment menus
proposal.trigger: Personal segment or team segment is opened by an admin/owner versus ordinary member.
proposal.expected: Personal controls are available; team rename/delete are restricted to admin/owner.
proposal.violation_example: A member can rename a shared team segment through its submenu.

necessity_rationale: Segment scope and admin/owner permissions control menu items (diff 667, 673), defining personal/team permissions.
responsibility_rationale: Segment data scope, role permissions, and menu actions connect across layers.

proposal.behavior: Show only enabled and selected workspace calendars
proposal.trigger: A workspace has enabled and disabled subscriptions and the view selects a subset.
proposal.expected: Only enabled IDs selected by the view contribute external entries.
proposal.violation_example: A disabled or unselected calendar leaks into the view.

necessity_rationale: Subscriptions are filtered by enabled status and membership in viewIds (diff 5011, 5019-5020), defining calendar-entry selection.
responsibility_rationale: Enabled/selected filtering occurs within the subscription-list pipeline.
